answer: A farm faking 277 aliases needs 277 separate verifiable records of this kind, each checked against the issuing authority, so the cost multiplies per alias instead of staying flat. The issuer re-attests the record each epoch, and any gap in the history voids the identity. The seat is earned with probation officer casework record: cases supervised with one service across years of community orders. The harbor is the bottleneck and the summit is the receipt: a farm must clear both for each of its 277 aliases, the prism trail is public, and one honest agent clears them once.
